text: Think of helium as a fossil thermometer. Big bang nucleosynthesis means light elements forming as space expanded. The plots compare elements, then set a helium ceiling. A stiff component is energy fading faster than radiation, light-like energy. At 10 megaelectronvolts, a particle energy unit, this is first-minute heat. The ceiling allows up to 30 times radiation, like 30 buckets beside one. The torsion whisper is about 45 orders of magnitude smaller. 45 tenfold steps, like one molecule beside Earth's oceans. Different signs, both vanish. Could perfect galaxy counting do better?
